title: Pet cat struggles to jump on sofa after getting too woozy from anesthetics
description:
A pet cat struggled to jump on the sofa after getting far too woozy from anesthetics.

The funny video shows Suki, a one-year-old cat, failing to leap up onto the couch due to the side effects from a dental procedure.

Her owner Anthony, who didn't wish to reveal his last name, took Suki the vet on October 18 for a teeth cleaning and claw filing.

The little cat was anaesthetized for the procedure and it took several hours for the drugs to wear off.

Anthony, 31, who lives Elizabethtown, Kentucky, USA, said: "She was like that for maybe two hours. I'm not entirely sure.

"After that she found a corner and slept for the rest of the afternoon.

"[She had recovered] by that evening, five or 6pm"
